candidates.name: Austin Restroom Partitions (Breakthrough General Contractors)
candidates.partition_evidence: Site lists restroom partition and stall installation, repair, hardware replacement and accessory installation. Works as a Division 10 subcontractor on commercial builds and finish-outs.
candidates.reason: An Austin-based contractor that installs and repairs commercial restroom partitions. Its FAQ says it is an installer, not a partition dealer, and that it works with any brand, so it fits the referral model well.
red_flags: Contact email is a Gmail address
No license/registration or reviews shown on site; Austin contractor registration not confirmed
Only one testimonial on site, no rating seen

license.name: Austin Restroom Partitions (Breakthrough General Contractors)
license.registry: City of Austin Building and Trade Contractor Services registration
license.note: Austin requires general and trade contractors to register with Building and Trade Contractor Services before permits are issued or activated. The registration page and the AB+C Portal (abc.austintexas.gov) offer no public registered-contractor lookup, and the Austin open-data catalog (datahub.austintexas.gov) has no contractor registry dataset. Confirm with BTCS through its appointment or live chat options. A search of Austin's 'Issued Construction Permits' open data (3syk-w9eu) for 'Breakthrough' and 'Austin Restroom' found no permits. Checked 2026-11-19.
